To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the structure of the Fab fragment of a synthetic HuCAL antibody was solved at 1.9 A resolution and that the crystals were pseudo-merohedrally twinned.
The structure of a Fab fragment of the synthetic antibody f3p4 is presented.
the crystal structure of the antibody fragment f3p 4, which was designed for binding the sodium citrate transporter CitS, was solved to 1.92 Å resolution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure of a synthetic antibody fragment, which is the first of its kind to be solved.
the development of novel methods and tools to facilitate the design of synthetic antibody libraries and to improve the efficiency of the antibody selection procedure.
the structure and dynamics of the antibody f3p4 Fab fragment and with the development of a new method for twinning analysis and refinement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Fab fragment structure is not a perfect match for any of the computational models but is close to the model that was generated from the sequence of the selected antibody.
the structure of f3p4 is not identical to its computationally generated model but is very similar to it, and that the differences are mainly in the loops that are involved in ligand binding.
the Fab f3p4 structure is a good model to study the binding of CitS, but that this particular Fab is not the best model to study the structural basis of the binding of CitM.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have solved the structure of the antibody f3p4 at 1.9 A resolution.
we have solved the structure of a Fab fragment with a high resolution and that this structure is of high quality.
the structure determination of Fab f3p4 was a challenging exercise, but the result was worth the efforts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, despite the fact that the Fab fragment f3P4 is a synthetic antibody, its structure is very similar to those of other Fab fragments.
the structure of f3p4 is very similar to that of the Fab fragment of an antibody from the HuCAL phage display antibody library.
